1. Heard learned counsel for applicants and the learned A.G.A.
2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 1130/9 of 2007 (State vs. Vivek Goel & others), arising out of Case Crime No. 23 of 2006, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Meerut, as well as charge sheet, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Meerut.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that compromise deed have been filed by the parties before the trial court, but no copy of the said compromise deed is available on record.
It is further submitted that the parties wants to file fresh compromise deed before the trial court concerned.

Therefore, no useful purpose would be served in continuing the proceedings before the court below Vivek And Others vs State Of U.P And Another on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74072867/
1 and the same is not only sheer wastage of time of the Court but also abuse of process of law.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned AGA, however, submits that it is the concerned court below, which has to verify the fact as to whether the parties have entered into compromise, hence the applicants may approach the concerned court below and move an application along with copy of compromise between the parties,
which will be decided in accordance with law.

5. In view of the above, the applicants and the opposite party no. 2 are directed to appear before the court below along with fresh compromise and an application for verification of compromise deed so filed as well as a certified copy of this order within two weeks from today.

It is expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise and after ensuring their presence, pass an appropriate order with respect to the same in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of two months from today.

While passing the order verifying the compromise, the concerned court shall also record the statement of the applicants and the opposite party no. 2 as to whether all the terms and conditions mentioned in the original compromise deed,
so filed, have been fulfilled or not.

6. The court in that scenario will allow the applicants and the opposite party no. 2 to obtain certified copy of the report as well as compromise and it will be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
7. For a period of two months, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 17.11.2023 v.k.updh.
